params.owner_: The address that approved the allowance

params.amount: The number of tokens the spender may transfer

params.wallet: The address to query the balance of

returns._0: The token balance, or 0 if the week has been burned

burnAll(uint256).details: Uses burnedWeeks mapping so balanceOf returns 0 for that week without iterating addresses

constructor.details: Sets the owner to msg.sender, initializes token metadata. No tokens are minted on deployment.

returns._0: The current week as block.timestamp / 7 days

mint(address,uint256,uint256).details: Called by the admin at the start of each week to load students with their weekly swipes

params.amount: The number of tokens to mint (1-6)
params.to: The address to mint tokens to
params.week: The week epoch to mint for

redeemSwipe(address).details: Called by an approved dining terminal when a student pays for a meal

params.wallet: The student's wallet address to burn a swipe from

transfer(address,uint256).details: Used for peer-to-peer swipe sending (the "Send Swipe to Friend" feature)

params.amount: The number of tokens to transfer
params.to: The address to transfer tokens to

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: Caller must have been approved by `from` via approve()

params.amount: The number of tokens to transfer
params.from: The address to transfer tokens from
params.to: The address to transfer tokens to

allowance(address,address).notice: Returns the remaining allowance a spender has on behalf of an owner

approve(address,uint256).notice: Approves a spender to transfer tokens on behalf of msg.sender

approveDining(address).notice: Approves an address as an authorized dining terminal

approvedDining(address).notice: Addresses approved to call redeemSwipe(). Represents dining hall terminals.

balanceOf(address,uint256).notice: Returns the token balance for a wallet in a given week

burnAll(uint256).notice: Burns all tokens for a given week epoch by marking it burned

burnedWeeks(uint256).notice: Tracks which weeks have been burned. When true, balanceOf returns 0 for that week.

currentWeek().notice: The current week epoch, computed from block.timestamp / 7 days.

decimals().notice: Decimals: 0 — meal swipes are whole units, no fractional swipes

mint(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Mints tokens to an address for a given week epoch

owner().notice: Deployer address. Has exclusive rights to mint and manage approved dining addresses.

redeemSwipe(address).notice: Burns exactly 1 token from wallet for the current week

revokeDining(address).notice: Revokes an address's authorization as a dining terminal

totalSupplyByWeek(uint256).notice: Total tokens minted for each week epoch. Used for accounting and burn verification.

transfer(address,uint256).notice: Transfers tokens from msg.sender to another address, scoped to the current week

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).notice: Transfers tokens from one address to another using an allowance
